visual_argument: With the type covered, a reader counts two stacks of identical weights in two metals: the brass stack of the chatbot is visibly larger than the blued stack of the platform that watches it, and the four empty wells in the case are the reserve.
build_risk: Frame 3 is a TXBENCH plan relief of 39 small slotted weights in a fitted case, the representation no. 62 lost four rounds to when its relief read as a flat mottled card at 432 px. Three metals and empty felt wells must separate at feed size and every weight must cast. Implementation: TXBENCH.relief with weights 30 px proud under the chassis key at elevation 13, per-material specular, a keyMask pool, and a fallback to a txthree oblique of the open case if one repair fails.
distinct_from_recent: No. 60 was return plates and tanks in an exterior lastLight yard, no. 61 a drone and dock with two generic offices, no. 62 tower sections and a county relief at landscape scale. This deck's subject is a 0.6 m tabletop instrument in brass, blued steel, pecan and chalk, seen at macro and plan distance, with one interior lit by a single window and no industrial model, screen or operator.
